raw_segments.text: Old Manx Sailor. I wonder whether those jolly lads bethink them of what they are dancing
over. I'll dance over your grave, I will. That's the bitterest threat of your night
women that beat headwinds round corners. Oh, Christ. To think of the green navies and
the green-sculled crews. Well, well, be like the whole world's a ball as you scholars
have it, and so tease right to make one ballroom of it. Dance on, lads, you're young. I was
